title: IREFOX Profound 400 review
notes: Exact reviewed 2023 build uses Shimano 105 R7000 mechanical 2×11, a 50/34T crank and a SunRace 34T cassette cog; the article does not state the cassette small cog or full range. It also reports cable-actuated hydraulic disc brakes with 160 mm rotors, aluminum wheels and Schwalbe 700×40C tires. The review describes 40C as the observed maximum and relaxed, stable, comfortable handling, but supplies no complete-bike weight or measured stiffness result. The 40C statement is not treated as a manufacturer maximum-clearance specification.
